case_results.question: Explain the attention mechanism in simple language.

attempt_results.question: Explain the attention mechanism in simple language.
attempt_results.answer: Attention lets a model look at different parts of a sequence and decide which parts matter most for a task. In self‑attention, each token can weigh every other token, producing a weighted sum that captures the sequence’s meaning. This mechanism has helped tasks like reading comprehension and abstractive summarization.

attempt_results.question: Give one example that helps explain the main concept.
attempt_results.answer: One example is the sinusoidal positional encoding: each position is represented by a vector whose components are sinusoids with wavelengths ranging from \(2\pi\) to \(10000\cdot2\pi\). This lets the model learn to attend to different positions by comparing these encodings. The idea is that the model can easily learn to attend by using these geometric‑progression wavelengths.
